### UGCDownload

```ts
sdk.SteamRemoteStorage.UGCDownload(hContent: bigint | number, unPriority: number): Promise<RemoteStorageDownloadUGCResult_t>
```

```cpp
SteamAPICall_t UGCDownload( UGCHandle_t hContent, uint32 unPriority )
```

> Downloads a UGC file.  A priority value of 0 will download the file immediately,
> otherwise it will wait to download the file until all downloads with a lower priority
> value are completed.  Downloads with equal priority will occur simultaneously.

### UGCRead

```ts
sdk.SteamRemoteStorage.UGCRead(hContent: bigint | number, pvData: Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer | null | undefined, cubDataToRead: number, cOffset: number, eAction: EUGCReadAction): { result: number; pvData: Uint8Array }
```

```cpp
int32 UGCRead( UGCHandle_t hContent, void * pvData, int32 cubDataToRead, uint32 cOffset, EUGCReadAction eAction )
```

> After download, gets the content of the file.
> Small files can be read all at once by calling this function with an offset of 0 and cubDataToRead equal to the size of the file.
> Larger files can be read in chunks to reduce memory usage (since both sides of the IPC client and the game itself must allocate
> enough memory for each chunk).  Once the last byte is read, the file is implicitly closed and further calls to UGCRead will fail
> unless UGCDownload is called again.
> For especially large files (anything over 100MB) it is a requirement that the file is read in chunks.

| Parameter | C++ type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `hContent` | `UGCHandle_t` |  |
| `pvData` | `void *` | Buffer Steam writes `cubDataToRead` bytes into. Omit to have one allocated. Returned in the result object. |
| `cubDataToRead` | `int32` |  |
| `cOffset` | `uint32` |  |
| `eAction` | `EUGCReadAction` |  |

Valve: <https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamRemoteStorage#UGCRead>
